name: 94304 · Palo Alto, CA
findings: ZIP 94304 (Palo Alto) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94304 (Palo Alto) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94304 (Palo Alto) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).
